title: JusticeHub - Navigate Justice Effortlessly
tagline: Justicehub is a platform where users can file public and personal complaints, incentivize the system for priority, and view other complains with evidences stored on blockchain.
description:
In the traditional complaint system there is no proper way of handling the cases, there is no proper portal to view complaints or check for others complaints.
So we have built a platform where users can file complaints by being anon. By incentivizing the system users can prioritize their complaints and get the attention of authority easily.
User can also hire advocates for their cases or consult them online.

how_its_made:
We ran into several challenges while developing the platform.
The very important thing in our platform is the working flow which took a lot of time to figure out.
As we have build this in just 24 hours we got a lot of bugs in a short span but we somehow managed to fix them and make our MVP ready :)
